title: KPOP Demon Hunters really said altos can be heroes too #kpopdemonhunt...
transcript: y'all I finally watched K pop Demon Hunters I know I am behind but this is so good you haven't watched K pop Demon Hunters yet it is an animated musical about this girl group of demon hunters who is tasked at protecting the human world from the demon world by maintaining this magical barrier and they do that through their music so a lot of the story is told through the songs I of course love a musical and this is a really good musical but I also love media that is geared towards children that is not afraid to tackle dark issues and K pop Demon Hunters is essentially about mental health the film also heavily relies on Korean mythology and art and culture as a whole and I think as we talk about these conversations of diversity in media there's something so thrilling about all of the deep dives into the cultural aspects of this movie and coming off of the maybe happy ending discourse I think K pop Demon Hunters is the perfect example of a universal story where everybody around the world can relate to the topics being talked about in K pop Demon Hunters but the Korean culture is so vital to how they chose to tell this story in this film like I said from a musical standpoint the songs are so good one they're just good k pop songs and from a musical perspective they're good at not just telling the arc of these characters and moving forward the plot but they're also good at telling the story from just the music level like just looking at the voice parts that rumi has in each of these songs as the film goes on is character building through music feel like this is one of those movies that's gonna define a generation like for kids today this is their Shrek and if you haven't watched it yet it is on Netflix I cannot recommend this enough especially if you're a fan of musicals
